body: {"query":"~DeclareGeometry(@aoi)~ SELECT @aoi = geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON((-76.9710 38.9100,-76.9650 38.9100,-76.9650 38.9150,-76.9710 38.9150,-76.9710 38.9100))', 4326); SELECT P.mukey, P.mupolygongeo.STIntersection(@aoi).STAsText() AS wkt FROM mupolygon P WHERE P.mupolygongeo.STIntersects(@aoi) = 1","format":"JSON+COLUMNNAME"}

{"query":"SELECT mu.mukey, mu.muname, mu.mukind, l.areasymbol, l.areaname, sa.saverest, ma.drclassdcd, ma.hydgrpdcd, ma.wtdepannmin, ma.flodfreqdcd, ma.pondfreqprs, ma.aws0150wta FROM mapunit mu JOIN legend l ON l.lkey = mu.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog sa ON sa.areasymbol = l.areasymbol LEFT JOIN muaggatt ma ON ma.mukey = mu.mukey WHERE mu.mukey IN (128578,128583,128584,128585,128586,128591,128603,128613,128638,128639,128652,128653,128654,128655,128659,128689,128690)","format":"JSON+COLUMNNAME"}

{"query":"SELECT c.mukey, c.cokey, c.compname, c.comppct_r, c.majcompflag, c.compkind, c.drainagecl, c.hydgrp, h.hzdept_r, h.hzdepb_r, h.awc_r, h.ph1to1h2o_r, h.sandtotal_r, h.claytotal_r, (SELECT TOP 1 tg.texdesc FROM chtexturegrp tg WHERE tg.chkey = h.chkey AND tg.rvindicator = 'Yes') AS texdesc, (SELECT MIN(h2.ksat_r) FROM chorizon h2 WHERE h2.cokey = c.cokey) AS ksat_min, (SELECT TOP 1 h3.hzdept_r FROM chorizon h3 WHERE h3.cokey = c.cokey AND h3.ksat_r IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h3.ksat_r ASC, h3.hzdept_r ASC) AS ksat_min_depth, (SELECT SUM((h4.hzdepb_r - h4.hzdept_r) * h4.awc_r) FROM chorizon h4 WHERE h4.cokey = c.cokey AND h4.hzdept_r < 150) AS aws150 FROM component c LEFT JOIN chorizon h ON h.cokey = c.cokey AND h.hzdept_r = (SELECT MIN(hzdept_r) FROM chorizon WHERE cokey = c.cokey) WHERE c.mukey IN (128578,128583,128584,128585,128586,128591,128603,128613,128638,128639,128652,128653,128654,128655,128659,128689,128690) ORDER BY c.mukey, c.comppct_r DESC","format":"JSON+COLUMNNAME"}

{"query":"SELECT c.cokey, cm.month, cm.flodfreqcl, cm.floddurcl, cm.pondfreqcl, cm.ponddurcl FROM component c JOIN comonth cm ON cm.cokey = c.cokey WHERE c.mukey IN (128578,128583,128584,128585,128586,128591,128603,128613,128638,128639,128652,128653,128654,128655,128659,128689,128690) AND (cm.flodfreqcl NOT IN ('None') OR cm.pondfreqcl NOT IN ('None'))","format":"JSON+COLUMNNAME"}

{"query":"SELECT c.cokey, cm.month, MIN(sm.soimoistdept_r) AS depth FROM component c JOIN comonth cm ON cm.cokey = c.cokey JOIN cosoilmoist sm ON sm.comonthkey = cm.comonthkey WHERE c.mukey IN (128578,128583,128584,128585,128586,128591,128603,128613,128638,128639,128652,128653,128654,128655,128659,128689,128690) AND sm.soimoiststat = 'Wet' GROUP BY c.cokey, cm.month","format":"JSON+COLUMNNAME"}
